headline: Executive order extends the life of the National Bioethics Advisory Commission, a federal advisory panel on ethics in biology and medicine.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 12975, which set up the National Bioethics Advisory Commission. Based on its title, it extends how long the commission is allowed to keep operating. No summary was provided, so details such as the new end date or any other changes are not stated here.

who_it_affects.group: Members and staff of the National Bioethics Advisory Commission
who_it_affects.how: They can continue the commission's advisory work for a longer period than first planned.

who_it_affects.group: Federal officials who receive the commission's advice
who_it_affects.how: They can keep receiving the commission's reports and recommendations on ethical questions in biology and medicine.
